messages:
Priya Rao: Quick check — bringing Lighthouse-2.7B into the catalog. Staging canary keeps failing the license gating step (legal says CLA missing). Can owners confirm status?
Jasper Li: I can pick up the legal ping. @LegalBot do we have the exact missing item?
LegalBot: License scan shows model metadata lists "Apache-2.0" but upstream cited mixed data sources; legal needs the upstream contributor list + dataset provenance doc. See https://redwood.example.com/legal/queue/428
Marta Nunez: I'll ask the model maintainer for provenance. ETA EOD. FYI perf team flagged that 512-token throughput is ~3% below baseline on A100.
Samir Patel: Perf notes: 3 runs on staging: median token/s 430 vs baseline 445. Tail latency ok. Possible tokenization mismatch or kv-cache issue.
Diego Gomez: Infra: build fails on certain AVX nodes during quant conversion.
Diego Gomez: ```
[ERROR] quantize: cannot load libaio.so.1
container: quay.redwood/lighthouse:2.7b-quant
```
Nina Chen: That's the AVX variant mismatch — we need a tiny base-image tweak. I'll push a fix to infra-ops and run a rebuild.
Jasper Li: Thanks @Nina, once infra rebuilds I'll re-run the perf harness. @Priya let's hold launch gate until legal + perf pass.
Priya Rao: Agreed. Action log: Jasper -> legal follow-up, Marta -> provenance doc, Nina -> infra image fix, Samir -> perf rerun after rebuild. I'll track in the catalog ledger and ping next status at 17:30 PT. :spiral_calendar:
Samir Patel: Quick note — if perf doesn't recover, propose trying the -q4_0 quant profile that's worked for similar models.
Priya Rao: Noted. If that happens, we may need a short rollback plan in Dedicated pools. Anyone object? :thumbsup:
Jasper Li: :+1:
Marta Nunez: :+1:
Diego Gomez: :+1:
Nina Chen: Will post the infra PR link when ready.
Priya Rao: Thanks all — I'll post a short follow-up thread with checklist items once infra PR and provenance doc land.
